author: T. S. Bloom
title: Rancho Cucamonga Medicaid Dental Services payments reach $1,912,158 in 2024
text:
In 2024, Medicaid providers in Rancho Cucamonga billed a total of $1,912,158 for services falling under the Dental Services category, according to figures from the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services Medicaid Provider Spending database. This represents a 4.6% increase over the prior year, which saw $1,828,364 in claims for these same services.
Medicaid, a state-administered public health insurance program with joint federal and state funding, covers low-income people and families, seniors, children, and individuals with disabilities. This makes it a major component of the U.S. health care landscape.
Because Medicaid is funded through taxpayer contributions, community billing levels give insight into how public health funding is distributed locally.
The Dental Services category includes a selection of Medicaid-covered procedures defined by the type of care rendered, grouped using standardized HCPCS and CPT codes. In this report, codes were attributed to a single service category based on established code prefixes and ranges. This approach helps analyze trends accurately over time by preventing duplication and maintaining precise rankings across years.
Despite an increase in Medicaid spending among several service categories, Dental Services ranked seventh in Rancho Cucamonga by total Medicaid payments for 2024.
Statewide, Dental Services placed 11th in terms of overall Medicaid payment categories in California for 2024.
From 2019 through 2024, Medicaid payments for Dental Services in Rancho Cucamonga grew by $1,305,494—an increase of 215.2%. Some periods within this timeframe, including 2021 and 2022, experienced particularly significant year-over-year gains.
Although Dental Services spending was dispersed across Rancho Cucamonga, payment volumes were highly concentrated within certain ZIP codes. The largest Medicaid payments in 2024 for Dental Services were reported in ZIP code 91730, at $1,268,118; ZIP code 91739, at $378,310; and 91701, which recorded $145,786. Together, these top 3 ZIP codes represented 93.7% of the city’s total Dental Services Medicaid payments for the year.
Medicaid payments within the Dental Services group in Rancho Cucamonga were also largely centered on a limited portion of unique billing codes.
During the same period, Medicaid Dental Services payments in the city grew by 4.6%, in contrast with a 6.6% rise in total Medicaid claim payments across all categories in Rancho Cucamonga.
According to the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, combined federal and state Medicaid expenditures totaled about $871.7 billion in fiscal year 2023, making up about 18% of national health expenditures. This was a notable increase from roughly $613.5 billion in 2019, prior to the COVID-19 pandemic.
This jump corresponds to a roughly 40% hike over several years, primarily the result of expanded program participation and elevated service use during and following the pandemic.
Recent federal budget legislation passed during the Trump administration introduced significant initiatives to curtail federal Medicaid contributions and overhaul the program. For instance, the “One Big Beautiful Bill Act,” enacted in 2025, is estimated to reduce federal Medicaid spending by more than $1 trillion over the next 10 years. The legislation includes new policies such as work requirements and greater cost-sharing, which may result in reduced coverage and funding for some Medicaid beneficiaries. States are expected to carry more financial responsibility as federal Medicaid growth is limited, despite the program providing coverage to tens of millions of Americans.
